patterns.purpose: Balance bounded autonomous delivery with shared discipline standards and lightweight cross-cutting expertise.
Prevent duplicate implementation by allowing exactly one canonical implementation stream and explicit lease per bounded Work Unit.
Use spare capacity on non-conflicting specialist lanes instead of duplicate implementation.
Require deterministic CI plus independent non-author review on the same exact candidate SHA.
Treat quota/cost uncertainty as degraded capacity rather than permission to spend.
Use indexes and deterministic repository evidence before expensive model context.
Evaluate new agent infrastructure beside the authoritative path before it is allowed to control decisions.

patterns.source: MIT-licensed upstream specialist profiles + OneCompany role contracts
patterns.purpose: Apply task-specific professional lenses to actors without confusing a prompt persona with an actor, lease, or authority.
Measure progress by durable artifacts, not acknowledgements, heartbeats, or claimed activity.
Pin external behavior-bearing dependencies and make upstream upgrades explicit reviewed decisions.
